abstract.t: This document specifies the Agent Settlement Protocol (ASP), an HTTPS and JSON-RPC application protocol for authorized execution of tasks by software agents in different administrative domains. ASP defines agent service discovery, certificate-bound task authorization, budget-limited recursive delegation, asynchronous execution, cryptographically signed usage records, and clearinghouse reconciliation. An Agent Clearinghouse (ACR) issues short-lived authorization tokens, reserves delegated budgets, receives Agent Detail Records (ADRs), and computes net obligations within a settlement window. ASP does not define a new URI scheme, a universal agent registry, or a payment rail. Its purpose is to make cross- domain agent execution and accounting interoperable while leaving the agents' internal models, tools, and business arrangements outside the protocol.
